note: Snapshot of the uncommitted typed protocol implementation; each file pinned by SHA-256. Portable allocator and numeric adapters live alongside it.

adaptations.local_auth.c: Valid-password HTTP login replaces the least recently used session when all four slots are occupied; other transports retain the lab policy.
adaptations.typed_wire.inc: All parser/writer entry points reject the JSON format; MessagePack/CBOR only.
adaptations.printbuf.h: Bounded portable printbuf adapter, no JSON DOM.
adaptations.json_heap.h: libc allocation shim for the shared bounded writer.
